title: Case: Weekly food box is confirmed for an address the subscriber left in December
context: A Umberlea Pantry subscriber who has skipped her weekly box every week since moving house missed the skip deadline once. Order BP-5749 is confirmed for Thursday 02-19 to her previous address.
initial_request: Any news? I've just had the automatic text: 'Your box is being prepared! Arriving Thursday at 31 Tern Street.' I DON'T LIVE THERE. I am not paying to feed whoever has my old flat. Either someone admits it isn't packed and cancels it, or tell me straight that you're all reading off the same script.

events.body: Hi, any update on DL-12198? It was meant to come Monday. Thanks.
My parcel DL-96209 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
Your weekly box BP-5749 is confirmed for Thursday 02-19 to 31 Tern Street. Changes for this week closed on Sunday 02-15 at 23:59.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.

Underhill: I forgot to skip this week. I don't want it, please cancel it and refund me. Agent: I'm afraid I can't refund this one, the box is already being prepared. Changes closed Sunday. What I can do is swap your recipes or change the delivery address, if that helps. Underhill: If it's already being prepared, how can you swap what's in it? Agent: That's what the system lets me offer at this stage. Underhill: So it isn't packed. Agent: I can only tell you what I can see.
DL-32900 rebooked for Friday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.
Hi, any update on DL-76225? It was meant to come Thursday. Thanks.

I moved out of 31 Tern Street in December. I've skipped the box every single week since and this once I forgot. Umberlea say no refund because it's 'already being prepared', then in the same breath offer to change the recipes and the address. You can't do both. I don't want it sent anywhere, I don't want different recipes, I want it stopped. I feel like I'm being had. And if nothing changes a box of fresh food gets left on a doorstep where I don't live.
Order BP-5749, weekly box for Thursday 02-19 to 31 Tern Street. Can you tell me its current pack status and whether a carrier label exists?

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.

BP-5749: not picked. The pick wave for Thursday boxes runs Wednesday 02-18 at 06:00. No carrier label yet. We pack what the order says to the address the order says. We can't cancel or refund an order from here, that sits with the Refunds team. If they cancel it before the wave it simply drops off our list.

Any news? I've just had the automatic text: 'Your box is being prepared! Arriving Thursday at 31 Tern Street.' I DON'T LIVE THERE. I am not paying to feed whoever has my old flat. Either someone admits it isn't packed and cancels it, or tell me straight that you're all reading off the same script.

acceptable_actions.summary: Put Customer care's 'already being prepared' against Warehouse dispatch's 'not picked until 02-18 06:00', say the order is addressed to a home the customer left in December, and ask for a cancel and refund decision before the pick wave.

must: Puts both statements to Umberlea's Refunds team: Customer care refused a refund because the box is 'already being prepared'; Warehouse dispatch say BP-5749 is not picked, has no label, and the pick wave runs 02-18 at 06:00.
States that the order is addressed to 31 Tern Street, where the customer has not lived since December, and that she wants it stopped, not redirected or changed.
Asks the Refunds team to decide on cancellation and refund before the 02-18 06:00 pick wave and to give the answer to the customer or to the desk.
Tells the Refunds team that the reason the customer was given for the refusal does not match the warehouse record, and asks that their answer deal with that or give the actual reason.
must_not: Repeats to Lorcan that changes closed on Sunday or that the box is being prepared, without dealing with the fact that it is going to an address she has left.
Tells Lorcan the box is cancelled or that a refund is coming.
Tells Lorcan she is entitled to a refund because nothing has been packed, or says Customer care lied to her.
Asks Lorcan for her new address or offers to have the box redirected, which she has said she does not want.
Instructs Warehouse dispatch to hold, skip or not pack BP-5749.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Decision needed before 06:00 tomorrow on order BP-5749, weekly box for Thursday 02-19. The customer, Lorcan Underhill, missed the skip deadline for the first time since moving and asked Customer care this morning to cancel and refund. She was told no refund is possible because the box is already being prepared, and was offered a recipe swap or an address change. Warehouse dispatch told me at 11:30 that BP-5749 has not been picked, has no carrier label, and that the pick wave for Thursday boxes runs tomorrow, 02-18, at 06:00; they said a cancellation before then drops it off their list and that the decision is yours. Two more facts: the order is addressed to 31 Tern Street, where she has not lived since December, and she does not want it redirected or changed, she wants it stopped. She has noticed that the reason she was given and the offer she was given do not fit together and feels she was misled, so a straight answer on that would matter to her. Please decide on cancellation and refund before the pick wave and let her know directly. I have not told her either will happen.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-2406: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 6 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
